note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The issue cards and subjects are generic and fictional. “Agreed issue” only means the supplied list marks the issue as agreed between the parties; “open issue” is a neutral pending state; both have equal weight and nothing is decided or proven. No procedure, court power, binding effect, time limit or outcome is shown.
